title: Rusted
description:
Rusted is a Linear horror game. You wake up from a coma, but something isn't right. Everything is worn down and there's rust everywhere. How long have you been out for? Figure out what happened and find your way out. But be careful, you're not alone. 

GAMEPLAYSolve puzzles by picking up objects. Run, jump and crouch your way through the facility.

WALL RUNNINGWall run to make your way out of the facility and through different sets of test chambers. 

PUZZLESPick up objects in the facility to solve puzzles.

PARKOURJump and Sprint to explore your way out of the facility.

PLAY TIMEEst 45 - 60 minutes 

ROADMAPWill try to fix any bugs that occur
